description: Named variables of the AirScreamer's behaviour (chara/AirScreamer/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: air_screamer_modes
fields.note: Three 4-bit fields: role (0 wild, 1 bound to its spawn point, 3 large), side, attack set.

fields.name: air_screamer_push
fields.note: Knock-back: speed, pitch and heading of the push a hit gave.

fields.name: air_screamer_aim_x
fields.note: Where it aims an attack: in front of it towards Harry, or Harry's head.

fields.name: air_screamer_detour_x
fields.note: The point of a detour around an obstacle on the way to the target.
